Dimensions shown are CLEAR room dimensions; wall thickness 152.4 mm (assumed).
Balcony uses source 9′ × 2′6″; store uses source 4′6″ × 6′. Powder room depth inferred.
Bathroom 3 projects 152.4 mm east of Bedroom 3 to preserve both room sizes and a shared partition.
Not a construction drawing. Door swings, offsets, heights and orientation require a measured survey.
